name: Polanco (Spain)
description: White field with a red diagonal band at the lower hoist and a blue diagonal band at the upper fly, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Polanco (a tower and an apple above waves on blue).
history: Municipal flag of Polanco; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Polanco arms — tower and apple above waves
